scheme_name: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Additional Incentive on Generation of Employment
other_conditions: Eligible tourism projects/units/expansion projects of existing units set up on or after 22 February 2021 must apply.
Eligible hotel units that started commercial operation between 7 January 2015 and 31 December 2020 and could not apply under the 2015 scheme due to absence of a Bar in the hotel are also eligible.
Units may be in the private sector, co‑operative sector, joint sector, or companies/undertakings owned or managed by the State Government.
The project must be covered by a detailed feasibility report/project prepared for the purpose.
The project must have been approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Bank, or State Financial Institution.
The unit must hold a Registration Certificate, Date of Commencement Certificate and Eligibility Certificate issued by the West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation Limited.
benefits_summary: Provides an additional incentive of 60% of eligible project cost for 5 years in Group A‑D areas and for 10 years in Special Areas.
